Frequently Asked Questions

Sorbpack supplies DIN 55473 certified container desiccants directly to Ireland with 2–4 day EU delivery. We offer calcium chloride dry bags, chain hangers and blankets for 20ft and 40ft containers. Contact us at info@sorbpack.com or order directly on this website.
For a standard 20ft container we recommend 20 bags of 1kg. For a 40ft container, use 40 bags of 1kg. Not sure what you need? Contact us at info@sorbpack.com and we calculate the exact quantity for free based on your cargo type and route.
Calcium chloride desiccants absorb up to 300% of their own weight in moisture, compared to only 35% for silica gel. For maritime shipping containers on tropical routes, calcium chloride is far superior as it prevents container rain — the condensation that destroys cargo during long sea transits.
Yes, Sorbpack delivers container desiccants and cargo protection products to Ireland within 2–4 business days. We also ship to the Netherlands, Belgium and across the EU. Free shipping on orders over €500.
Yes. Our desiccants are non-toxic and safe for food cargo. The calcium chloride is encased in Tyvek packaging with a gelling agent — moisture is absorbed and locked as a gel, eliminating any risk of leakage onto your cargo. They comply with REACH regulations.
Yes. Orders of 5+ pallets qualify for reduced pricing. Orders over €5,000 qualify for industrial pricing tiers. Contact us at info@sorbpack.com with your container volume and we will provide a tailored quote within 24 hours.
